chunks: Everything that was in it from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Yaʿfūr, I have narrated from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-ʿAṭṭār—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh al-Barqī, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Yaʿfūr.

key_terms.الْبَرْقِيِّ: A relational epithet identifying Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh al-Barqī
key_terms.الْعَطَّارِ: A relational epithet identifying Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; the compiler’s statement of direct transmission through a chain
key_terms.عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ: A narrator from whom reports in this section are transmitted

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Yaʿfūr in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad for reports in the book transmitted from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Yaʿfūr. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission, which is essential in hadith scholarship for identifying the route by which a narration reached the compiler.
